# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment artifacts generated for the PhotoGallery repository.

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) — high-level application architecture and component relationship diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) — categorized external dependency inventory with modernization risks.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) — HTTP endpoint inventory, communication patterns, and service sequence.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) — persistence-layer summary for blob storage, data boundaries, and sensitivity notes.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) — configuration sources, runtime/build settings, and secrets handling inventory.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) — primary gallery workflows, business rules, and workflow sequence diagram.
